key_facts: The Air Force issued a Request for Information for new fighter jet engines, with a deadline of Aug. 28.

F-35 fighter deliveries and upgrades have been delayed by engine issues; a GAO report noted the engine contractor is still not delivering engines to contract specifications after 20 years of production.
B-52 modernization has been stalled in part by engine issues that raised costs by $3 billion and delayed initial operational capability by 15 months, per GAO.
The Air Force is embarking on a multiyear fighter engine procurement project envisioning more than 180 engines per year by 2034, citing engines for the F-15EX and F-16.
The RFI outlines five foundational pillars intended to shift procurement from legacy models toward incentivizing industry-led technological evolution and capacity expansion.
